decisions.decision: Match Windows 11 Task View with a captured and heavily blurred desktop under a dark neutral scrim, light shell cards, compact Segoe UI chrome, blue system focus, and large live DWM thumbnails that animate from each real window location. Omit the virtual-desktop strip and scale one-to-four-window groups to use most of the available work area.
decisions.rationale: The supplied Task View screenshot is the static composition target, and a native Windows 11 Task View capture establishes a roughly 300 ms ease-out opening transition with a reversed closing path.
